reasons.why: authored: B's dock/search (S-19): the search hook joins the engine it drives
authored: the search result types; read only by search once useDockSearch joins it
authored: B's dock/legibility (S-19): the backdrop-luminance sampler and its two helpers
authored: B's menu/sub: the submenu and its content and trigger (a peer set dominance cannot split, R-5 menu 16)
authored: B's menu/items: the item kinds (peer set)
authored: B15: use.ts names nothing; the file holds useSheetDetents (B-07)

declined.why: GlassDock.vue is the dock under its product name; nesting it in dock/glass-dock/ would make a second dock inside the dock, and its closure (morph, run, click integrity, shell props) reads dockContext, which the floor's row m02 pins in dock/composables/ (FD-2 would refuse the nesting cycle)
renderer/ is the authored name and already holds the WebGPU renderer, its uniforms and both WGSL programs; G's wgpu/ erased it (G-crit F-5)
detents/ is the authored concept (G-crit F-5); SheetContent.vue stays the sheet's content root
webgpu/ is the authored backend module (5 files); a 3-file level inside it adds a name for nothing
useViewTransition is anchored in motion/core (./motion-core publishes it); route/ stays as authored
